QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK BEFORE HIRING US FOR EMAIL MARKETING
Answers written and reviewed by Khalid Farhan, founder. Last reviewed November 2026.
How much does Email Marketing cost in Limerick?
Retainers from €1,500 a month. The exact figure depends on the size of the opportunity and the amount of work, so we do a free audit first and quote from that. There is no charge for the audit.
Do you work with businesses in Limerick?
Yes. We work with businesses in Limerick and across Ireland. Most of the work is done remotely with regular calls and a monthly report; Dublin-based clients can meet us in person.
What email platform do you work with?
We work with Klaviyo (e-commerce), Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Beehiiv (newsletters), and Resend. We'll recommend the right tool for your use case.
How do you grow our email list?
List growth is part of our strategy — through lead magnets, opt-in forms, paid acquisition, and referral programmes. Growing the list is as important as what you send.
What open rates should I expect?
Industry averages vary widely (15–30%). Our clients typically see above-industry open rates due to strong segmentation, subject line testing, and clean list management.
